# Arvane at Atiaiaba Lowest in Twelve Januaries

Gauges at the mouth of the Arvane recorded the lowest January level in twelve years. Hydrologists at the Federal University of Tekoku blame a weak rainy season upstream, compounded by "unlicensed withdrawals" along the middle course that no agency has yet catalogued. Water samples are pending. Both of Kunasai's great rivers flow north, so changes upstream affect Tekoku.
